'''Sollima''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Aleena/Legends|Aleena]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] active during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], and the owner of the [[Casino/Legends|casino]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] [[Hollow Moon]].

==Biography==
In [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] stole his accounting droid to use the information inside it against Sollima. In order to retrieve the droid he ordered [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Billal Batross]], both of whom owed Sollima money, to infiltrate the Imperial base and retrieve the droid, in exchange for him to forgive their debts. He also took [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] hostage to ensure that Han wouldn't just run away, and put the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] into the dueling arena on the [[Hollow Moon]]. However, when Solo and Batross returned with the droid, they brought the Imperials who wanted to arrest Sollima. Playing a scheme of trickery, the [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] managed to rescue Chewbacca in exchange for promising Sollima safe passage off the Hollow Moon (aboard the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']]). However, once the [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] left the [[Planet/Legends|planet]], Han pushed Sollima into the escape pod and launched it towards the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial fleet]], leaving the Empire to deal with him.
